Ecosystem reserve.methodology: 3M AAVE allocated to the ecosystem reserve, minus rewards already distributed through staking and farming sections

ecosystem-reserve-remaining.name: Ecosystem Reserve Remaining
ecosystem-reserve-remaining.methodology: Remaining undistributed AAVE in the ecosystem reserve. Distribution schedule is governed by Aave governance.

Staking Rewards.methodology: Tracks AAVE rewards distributed to token holders through staking

stkaave-incentives.name: stkAAVE Rewards
stkaave-incentives.methodology: Tracks rewards claimed from stkAAVE contract. Users stake AAVE tokens and receive AAVE rewards.

stkabpt-v1-incentives.name: stkABPT v1 Rewards
stkabpt-v1-incentives.methodology: Tracks rewards claimed from the original stkAAVE/ETH BPT contract. Users stake AAVE-containing LP tokens.

stkabpt-incentives.name: stkABPT v2 Rewards
stkabpt-incentives.methodology: Tracks rewards claimed from stkAAVE-wstETH BPT contract. Users stake AAVE-containing LP tokens.

Farming Incentives.methodology: Tracks AAVE rewards distributed to protocol users (lenders, borrowers, GHO users)

gho-incentives.name: GHO Incentives
gho-incentives.methodology: Tracks rewards claimed from GHO contract. These go to GHO minters/holders, not necessarily AAVE holders.

incentives-controller.name: Lending/Borrowing Rewards
incentives-controller.methodology: Tracks rewards claimed from AAVE IncentivesController. These go to lenders and borrowers, not necessarily AAVE holders.
